provenance: measured real embeddings with authored reference answers; no LLM calls

referenceAnswers.add-product: Provide the product name, unit, HSN, supported GST slab, cost and MRP. Review the registration and confirm it.
referenceAnswers.receive-stock: Describe the delivered product, quantity and unit. Include price changes only if intended. Review and confirm the stock receipt.
referenceAnswers.open-bill: Ask to start a bill, then name the products, quantities and units. Review each proposed change and confirm before finalizing payment.
referenceAnswers.edit-bill: Identify the draft bill and the product, then state the new quantity and unit. Review and confirm the edit.
referenceAnswers.void-bill: Identify the finalized bill and request a reversal. Review and confirm using the owner button; the system records the reversal.
referenceAnswers.invoice-pdf: Identify the finalized bill and ask for its PDF invoice. The bot generates and sends the document.
referenceAnswers.khata-payment: Name the customer and amount received. Review the payment and confirm using the owner button.
referenceAnswers.khata-charge: Name the customer and credit amount. For a sale of goods, build a bill and choose khata payment. Review and confirm the charge.
